name: Cap Toss
summary: A graduation card where a diploma unrolls, a gold seal stamps and seven graduates throw their caps
about: A full graduation page under a golden-hour arch (or spotlights at night): bunting spells out the class year, a diploma scroll unrolls with the graduate's name and degree, and a gold seal stamps it. Seven graduates on stage throw their caps, which spin, fall back with their tassels swinging and land in a burst of confetti. Type the name, degree, school, year and a message, then copy a link that opens the card made for them.
how: Open the page: the bunting rises, the diploma drops in and unrolls, the seal stamps and the caps fly by themselves.
Press Throw the caps (or the T key) to send every cap up again; tap one graduate to throw just theirs.
Swipe through falling caps to bat them back up; the counter keeps score, and the diploma tilts with your pointer.
Tap the gold seal to spin it.
In Make yours, type the name, degree, school, class year, a message and who it is from, or pick a ready message.
Copy the link (or Share on a phone) and send it; it opens this card with your words.
